summary: Batch program that sequentially reads the indexed CUSTOMER master file (CUSTFILE) and displays every customer record. A simple browse utility: open the file, loop read-and-display until end-of-file, then close. Any I/O error prints the file status and abends.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Announce start. Open the customer file. Loop until end-of-file: read the next customer record and, while not at end-of-file, display it. Close the file, announce end, and return.
paragraphs.notes: Driver; sequential read-and-display loop over the customer master.

paragraphs.name: 1000-CUSTFILE-GET-NEXT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the next customer record. On success ('00') display it; status '10' means end-of-file (16); any other status is an error (12). If OK continue; if end-of-file set END-OF-FILE='Y'; otherwise report the error and abend.
branches: IF APPL-AOK ... ELSE IF APPL-EOF ... ELSE (abend)
paragraphs.notes: Same status-flag browse pattern as the other CBACT programs, over the customer master.

paragraphs.name: 0000-CUSTFILE-OPEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Open the customer file for input; on non-'00' status print an open error and abend.

paragraphs.name: 9000-CUSTFILE-CLOSE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Close the customer file; on non-'00' status print a close error and abend.

paragraphs.name: 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
paragraphs.pseudocode: Set abend code 999 and call CEE3ABD to force an abnormal end.

paragraphs.name: 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Format and display the file status code, handling VSAM extended (9nn) codes.
branches: IF IO-STATUS NOT NUMERIC OR IO-STAT1 = '9' ... ELSE
